title: Qwen3.6-27B RX 7900 XTX sole-raw Q4 rung and exact T16 tile-pressure rejection
scope: Actual-weight component screens used only to decide whether the predeclared sole-raw Q4 rung or a smaller exact T16 fused output tile warranted runtime integration. No kernel, wrapper, registry key, materialization policy, allocation, environment flag, or package default changed.

observed_mechanisms: raw block_q4_K source bytes with prequantized Q8_1 activations and RDNA3 sudot4
one wave per output-column group with rows 1-8 accumulated in registers
Vulkan Q4_K minimum term using the stored Q8_1 block sum split across two K16 contributions
CUDA/HIP Q4_K minimum term recomputing the corresponding signed integer sums
optional gate pointer and SWIGLU fusion in llama.cpp MMVQ only for the single-column destination case

candidate_ladder: raw Q4_K plus Q8_1 integer-sum col1/2/4/8 rows4
two-wave raw gate/up plus SiLU and correct split-kernel fallback
raw Q4_K WMMA prefill tiles 16x16 through 64x32
exact compact-T16 fused gate/up plus SiLU with output tile reduced from eight to four columns

cache_discipline.problem: A repeated 30-50 MiB single matrix fits in the RX 7900 XTX cache and made several raw candidates appear 8-23% faster. Production streams many distinct layer weights, and the 100+ MiB gate/up pair already reversed that result.
cache_discipline.adjudication: Repeat the fastest Vulkan-arithmetic candidate over distinct same-role pools whose raw and T16 payloads each exceed approximately 96 MiB. Report per-weight event medians; do not retain the favorable one-weight numbers.

disposable_dual_quality.decision: failed independently and was not considered for integration

exact_t16_tile_pressure.decision: reject exact tile4 and keep tile8

prefill_and_operation_completeness.result: The existing compact-T16 path remained fastest for attn_gate, attn_qkv, attn_q, attn_output, ffn_down, and ffn_gate across the raw 16x16 through 64x32 tile screen. Raw won only the small attn_k one-weight prefill leaf (191.289 versus 300.062 us), but its inclusive rows4 verifier route lost (11.466 versus 9.182 us). No tensor role therefore qualified raw as an operation-complete canonical format.
prefill_and_operation_completeness.hybrid_rule: No raw role was retained. A favorable cached leaf cannot justify different canonical bytes when the same role regresses another required operation, and no logical tensor may own both layouts.

memory_ceiling.conclusion: Even an otherwise free all-Q4 raw conversion cannot meet any external memory gate by itself. A role subset would save less.

correctness_disclosure.vulkan_arithmetic: Component KL stayed below 1.33e-6, but projection-local top-1 was 0.75 in isolated attn_qkv and attn_output cases. Because every cache-cold performance row already failed, the changed-association route was rejected before a full model quality admission run.
correctness_disclosure.production: Unchanged exact compact-T16 production remains the correctness authority.

decision.reason: Every production-representative cache-cold raw verifier pool regressed 12.53-65.73%, fused raw regressed 29.03-34.56%, compact T16 retained every broad prefill role, and maximum raw residency savings are insufficient for every memory gate. Exact T16 tile4 also regressed 9.60%.
decision.retained_path: sole compact Q4T16 with exact tile8 fused gate/up+SiLU and shared-B dense prefill
decision.reopen_condition: A new operation-complete source format or producer-fused transform that wins cache-cold verifier and populated prefill while saving enough whole-device memory; repeated one-weight cache-resident results are not a reopen condition.
